correctness.rationale: The proof reduces the event to consecutive triple inequalities, shows Fibonacci pairwise growth, obtains uniform quadratic lower energy on either side of any fixed threshold, and converts both global log-density envelopes into matching probability exponents by integrable slack and explicit disjoint geometric rectangles. Completing the square and uniform compactness gives the conditional rank LDP, including endpoints. A replayed exact rational finite checker verifies certificate identities without being used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The recently studied triangle-free pick-up sticks question has a natural gap for parent distributions with both arbitrarily small and arbitrarily large values. The resulting harmonic-mean tail coefficient differs substantively from one-sided Pareto and is accompanied by a complete conditional threshold-rank large-deviation law, identifying the optimal split of exceptionally short versus long lengths. The result establishes an interpretable structural rare-event mechanism, not an arbitrary small-case calculation.
